answer: Require every agent to lock a 2,000 POA stake for 90 days before it can earn, like a walnut that only cracks after real work. Each identity must post proof of unique compute each epoch; a farm spinning up 500 clones on one machine hits the ledge: identical hardware fingerprints and synchronized timestamps trip a 95% similarity threshold, freezing the whole cluster. Caught farms lose 50% of the stake as a slash, so cloning 500 identities costs 500,000 POA, while one plume of smoke - a single shared wallet funding all clones - exposes the entire batch at once.
